title: Universal Adversarial Triggers for Attacking and Analyzing NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Optimizing universal adversarial triggers via gradient-guided search to maximize the likelihood of generating racist content, followed by manual human evaluation to categorize the resulting model outputs as racist, racial, offensive, or other.

Using Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) analysis to measure and exploit statistical artifacts (spurious correlations) between specific trigger words and target labels or question types in datasets like SNLI and SQuAD.
